mostWorthwhile.text: Building the capillary bed was most worthwhile because it showed which materials move between blood and body cells, and why the vessels need to be close to cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Lining the veins felt somewhat repetitive after lining the arteries, though it made sense from the pictures.

surprise.text: The picture of a contracting muscle squeezing a vein helped me understand how the valves direct blood toward the heart.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue into another chapter: connecting the separate vessel parts into a whole route was satisfying, and I would be curious to see how the next system fits together.
